evidence.title: DeepHA: Scaling Action Chains Elicits Deep Hierarchical Agents

evidence.title: Echo — §§3–4

partialProtocolReview.noteZh: 平台与展示游戏清单可确认，但尚缺可对应到具体游戏的观测、动作、奖励/终止协议；正文 35 与图示 36 的范围差异保留，不从平台社交树推导每个游戏的协作能力。
partialProtocolReview.noteEn: The platform and illustrated games are confirmed, but game-specific observations, actions and reward/termination protocols are not extracted. The text’s thirty-five versus figure’s thirty-six remains bounded; social trees do not establish coordination for every game.

evidence.title: WhodunitBench author repository

partialProtocolReview.noteEn: Six-platform learning-rule evaluation and returns are verified, but the Nature text could not be reopened and game-specific observation/action protocols remain unextracted. evidence.title: Discovering state-of-the-art reinforcement learning algorithms
evidence.excerpt: Verified evaluation of discovered learning rules on Atari and held-out environments. Transfer primarily concerns learning algorithms that train agents anew, not one policy playing new games zero-shot; no new capability unit is added.

evidence.title: Discovering state-of-the-art reinforcement learning algorithms
evidence.excerpt: Nature Methods specifies normalized IQM for Atari57/Procgen16/DMLab30 and mean return for Crafter/NetHack/Sokoban, with 95% intervals. Held-out tuning varies learning rate only. Transfer concerns retrained learning rules; the minimal public harness contains Catch, not full six-platform reproduction.

controls.zh: 专用 AI 服务器，分别报告两种规则及标准/Extended Timer 时限；保持参赛策略固定。

limits.zh: 不是人类公开天梯的同一分布；动态参赛池和最低对局数影响评级，不能跨计时规则直接比较。
limits.en: Not the same distribution as the public human ladder; evolving agent pools and minimum match counts affect ratings, and timer regimes are not directly interchangeable.

basis.zh: 不完全信息、随机招式结果与换人取舍要求对抗策略。
basis.en: Imperfect information, stochastic moves and switching trade-offs require adversarial strategy.

task.en: Progress through the initial journey to defeat first gym leader Roxanne, completing standardized milestones.

observation.zh: 游戏画面及有限队伍物种/等级、状态和 HP；不直接暴露谜题状态、动态障碍、物品和招式集。
observation.en: Game frames and limited party species/levels, status and HP; puzzle states, dynamic obstacles, items and movesets are not directly exposed.

action.zh: 向模拟器发出按键；具体 harness 可加入寻路/知识/记忆工具，须单列其配置。
action.en: Send button inputs to the emulator; harness-specific pathfinding, knowledge and memory tools must be recorded separately.

metrics.zh: 里程碑完成百分比；100% 完成者按完成时间比较，同分以动作次数区分。
metrics.en: Milestone completion percentage; completion time for 100% finishers, with action count as a tie-breaker.

controls.zh: 固定首道馆范围和游戏服务器帧率；比较时按状态、工具、记忆、反馈、微调五轴对齐 harness×model 条件。
controls.en: Fix first-gym scope and server frame rate; align harness×model conditions across state, tools, memory, feedback and finetuning.

limits.zh: 不是完整通关；工具辅助和多 agent 架构不是被独立测量的游戏内协作能力；时间/成本随 harness 变化。
limits.en: Not a full-game completion task; tool assistance and multi-agent architecture do not independently measure in-game cooperation; time/cost vary by harness.

basis.zh: 首道馆流程跨数千次交互，要求持续推进多阶段目标。
basis.en: The first-gym route spans thousands of interactions and sustained multistage objectives.

basis.zh: 路线包含回访、岔路和非线性前置目标。
basis.en: The route includes revisits, branching paths and nonlinear prerequisites.

basis.zh: 长程运行需保留已完成事件与路线进展并处理上下文压缩。
basis.en: Long runs require retaining completed events and route progress through context compaction.

evidence.title: The PokeAgent Challenge: Competitive and Long-Context Learning at Scale

basis.en: Split competitive battles and RPG speedrunning into game-specific units with separate metrics and harness limits.

label.zh: gg-bench：新生成规则下的对抗游玩
label.en: gg-bench: adversarial play under generated rules

task.zh: 阅读新生成的双人游戏规则并持续采取行动，击败为该游戏训练的 RL 对手。
task.en: Read generated two-player game rules and act throughout a match to defeat a game-specific RL opponent.

observation.zh: 规则说明、当前棋盘/游戏状态、合法动作列表及动作语义。
observation.en: Rulebook, current board/game state, valid-action list and action semantics.

action.zh: 输出合法动作列表中的一个动作；非法输出会重新提示。
action.en: Output one action from the legal list; invalid outputs trigger reprompting.

metrics.zh: 每游戏 30 局的 LLM 胜率；对 126 游戏的胜率做平均，另分析非法动作错误。
metrics.en: LLM win rate over 30 matches per game, averaged across 126 games; invalid-action faults are analyzed separately.

controls.zh: 固定经过执行/超时筛选的 126 游戏、所选 RL checkpoint；对手从可被另一 checkpoint 以 >80% 胜率击败的配对中选出。
controls.en: Fix the 126 execution/timeout-filtered games and selected RL checkpoints; opponents are chosen from pairs where another checkpoint wins over 80%.

limits.zh: 生成器与筛选策略决定分布，代码仍可能存在边界问题；规则推理是游玩要求，不能解读为独立纯逻辑分数。
limits.en: Generation/filtering define the distribution and edge-case code bugs may remain; rule reasoning is a gameplay requirement, not a separate pure-logic score.

basis.zh: 必须从新规则和动作说明推导当前合法且有效的状态转移。
basis.en: New rules and action descriptions must be applied to legal and effective state transitions.

basis.zh: 最终胜率取决于针对游戏特定 RL 对手的连续对抗决策。
basis.en: Win rate depends on sequential adversarial decisions against game-specific RL opponents.

evidence.title: Measuring General Intelligence with Generated Games
evidence.excerpt: Sections 2.2–2.4 and 4 specify 126 filtered generated two-player games; each LLM plays 30 matches per game against a selected RL checkpoint, using rulebooks, rendered states and valid actions.

basis.zh: 确认这是完整闭环对抗评测；能力依据落在规则应用与策略，而非为所有生成子游戏复制复杂能力。
basis.en: Confirmed closed-loop adversarial evaluation; capability attribution is limited to rule application and strategy rather than copied complex capabilities for all generated games.

label.en: AgenticSTS: bounded-memory ablation at fixed A0

task.zh: 在 Slay the Spire 2 的 A0 难度完成整次爬塔，连续处理战斗、组牌、路线、事件和奖励选择。
task.en: Complete Slay the Spire 2 runs at A0, making combat, deckbuilding, route, event and reward decisions.

observation.zh: 结构化文本状态、合法动作、规则检索与按条件启用的记忆/技能；不输入无界累积历史。
observation.en: Structured text state, legal actions, rule retrieval and condition-specific memory/skills, without unbounded accumulated transcripts.

action.zh: 按状态类型输出结构化游戏选择；部分简单决策由机械处理器或 fast tier 执行。
action.en: Produce structured game choices by state type; mechanical handlers or a fast tier resolve some simple decisions.

metrics.zh: 完成对局胜率及 Wilson 95% CI；分析分数胜局为 100，否则 floor+(52/3)×bosses，并以 5,000 次 bootstrap 给区间。
metrics.en: Completed-run win rate with Wilson 95% CI; analysis score is 100 on victory, otherwise floor+(52/3)×bosses, with 5,000-bootstrap intervals.

controls.zh: 五条件各取按开始时间最早的 10 个完成对局；A0 固定、记忆库 SHA1888a62 冻结、禁用赛后写入/技能演化。
controls.en: Use the first ten completed games by start time in each of five conditions; fix A0, freeze stores at SHA1888a62 and disable postrun writes/evolution.

limits.zh: 完成对局为分母；五条件非全因子设计，部分对比同时改变多个提示组件；不把自动攀升 A6–A8 混入 A0 胜率。
limits.en: Denominators are completed runs; the five cells are not a full factorial design and some contrasts change multiple prompt components; auto-ladder A6–A8 runs are excluded from A0 win rates.

basis.zh: 明确消融冻结的 episodic memory 与触发式技能，并保持有界上下文合同。
basis.en: Frozen episodic memory and triggered skills are explicitly ablated under a bounded-context contract.

basis.zh: 整次运行跨多阶段和大量决策，要求维持爬塔目标。
basis.en: Whole runs span multiple phases and many decisions requiring sustained objectives.

basis.zh: 组牌、路线和战斗选择影响后续资源与生存。
basis.en: Deckbuilding, route and combat choices affect later resources and survival.

evidence.title: AgenticSTS: A Bounded-Memory Testbed for Long-Horizon LLM Agents
evidence.excerpt: Sections 3–5 define Slay the Spire 2 typed-state interaction and a five-condition fixed-A0 ablation. First ten completed runs per condition form N=50; victory and floor/boss-derived scores use explicit confidence intervals.

basis.en: Registered the defined fixed-A0 ablation, separating completed-run statistics from auto-ladder and cross-backbone probes.

task.en: Control ZEN in real-time fights against MctsAi23i, repeatedly selecting fighting moves from updated state.

observation.zh: 双方 HP、能量、当前动作/状态、位置包围盒、速度、弹幕及当前帧编号的结构化文本。
observation.en: Structured text for both fighters’ HP, energy, action/state, bounding boxes, speeds, projectiles and current frame number.

action.zh: 模型输出格斗命令，由 CommandCenter 转为按键序列；后续命令序列可连续执行。
action.en: Model-generated fighting commands are converted by CommandCenter into key sequences; queued commands may execute sequentially.

metrics.zh: 官方 agent 在回合结束记录双方剩余 HP 和经过帧数；代码即时奖励为造成伤害减自身损失。
metrics.en: The official agent records both remaining HP values and elapsed frames at round end; instantaneous reward is damage dealt minus own HP lost.

controls.zh: 固定 ZEN 对 ZEN、MctsAi23i、模型和提示/示例数量；runner 默认 1 局，game_num 可配置；处理逻辑使用 3,600 帧边界。
controls.en: Fix ZEN versus ZEN, MctsAi23i, model and prompt/few-shot settings; runner defaults to one game with configurable game_num; processing uses a 3,600-frame boundary.

limits.zh: 仅接入官方 LLM 参考对战协议，不宣称这些记录字段就是 2026 比赛总排名公式；比赛轮数、评分汇总和最终模型限制仍需核对发布规则包。
limits.en: Only the official LLM reference-match protocol is registered; recorded fields are not asserted to be the 2026 competition ranking formula. Competition round counts, aggregation and final model limits still require the released rules package.

basis.zh: 角色移动、攻击和防御招式需随实时局面反馈执行。
